name: iMessage — the bug · dark (horizontal)
description: Dark-mode variant of the live Messages conversation overlay (same Surface, theme chosen from paperColor). Over ~6s: a gray received bubble pops in, a three-dot typing indicator resolves into the next bubble, a heart tapback pops on, then a blue sent reply arrives with a Delivered → Read receipt, and it holds. Faithful modern Messages look BY DESIGN: near-black page, dark-gray (left) / blue (right) bubbles with grouped tail curls, an iOS/macOS header (contact avatar + name, FaceTime icon) and a bottom composer bar — flat screen, NO browser chrome, NO CSS glow. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

messages.text: the bottleneck was a console.log inside a hot loop
